ThinkByte: Raghu Gorrela, Harsha Thota, vinay kovvuri, Bharath MVS
Key Takeaways
Pradeep Veeramaneni and Harsha Thota reviewed budget and project scope, focusing on pricing and infrastructure to meet client goals.
Discussion centered on implementing a SQL-based agent for efficient data summarization and search across multiple industries.
Plans were made to develop new exam question papers from historical data, aiming to create a versatile question bank for future assessments.
Addressed data permissions and user access by planning a high-level architecture diagram to ensure proper backend user permissions and data security.

Budget
Discussed the features needed, infrastructure required, and recurring costs to provide a budget for a project.
Data Permissions and User Access
Understanding different user permissions within the application, especially concerning backend data storage and logic
Need to comprehend the scale of data, user base, and potential new permissions
Issue remains open
Plans to address these points in further discussions
Research Company Chatbot Implementation
Research company wants to use a chatbot for subscribed students to access a 300 gb document repository
Need to integrate Sharepoint and Onedrive repositories with the chatbot for efficient document access
Suggestions made to create filters for document retrieval
Decision
Use a chatbot to provide information from a 300 gb document repository to subscribed students
Repositories in Sharepoint and Onedrive will be used, but migration to a separate repository is recommended
Focus on building a SQL-based querying agent for retrieving raw data and summarizing it
Infrastructure needed includes a repository size of 300 GB with PDFs, Word, and Excel documents
Document Repository and Formats
Categorizing and structuring repositories in sharepoint and onedrive
Storing all documents in a vector database for easy summarization, search, and complex activities
Align data formats and cost requirements
Focus on file formats like PDFs, Word, and Excel
Data Summarization and Search Features
Developing a summarization feature for detailed outputs from excel data
Implementing search functionalities for industry-specific information
Analyzing different data sets to understand question patterns
Planning for future phases with a focus on building a SQL-based querying agent
Ongoing development discussions to address product limitations and determine feasible solutions
Current Tasks
Vinay Kovvuri and team are analyzing different population data for COVID infections in 2012 by region from multiple documents to understand patterns of questions and plan for future phases.
The team is working on creating new question papers for weekly and monthly exams using textbooks and sample question papers from the last few years.
Business Goals
To create a high-level architecture diagram for the use cases and discuss the details.
To align the data format and cost requirements based on discussions.
Pricing
Discussions led by Pradeep Veeramaneni and Harsha Thota focused on determining the minimum budget, required features, infrastructure needs, and recurring costs for the client's project.
The strategy involves offering different pricing options based on chosen features to align the client's business goals with their budget.

Understanding different question formats and answers
Utilizing textbooks and sample question papers from previous years
Exam question paper creation discussed by two individuals
Focus on creating a question bank with multiple options
Discussing budget considerations with potential Middle East customer
Ongoing development with plans to check additional details
